name: Costa Mesa Courtyards
demographics: Costa Mesa Courtyards attracts a diverse mix of middle to upper-middle income families and young professionals from the surrounding Costa Mesa and Newport Beach areas, with household incomes typically ranging from $75,000 to $150,000. The trade area serves a blend of established homeowners aged 35-65 and younger millennials aged 25-40 who value convenience and quality dining options. Visitors are drawn to the center's restaurant-focused tenant mix and prefer casual dining experiences, often visiting during evening hours and weekends for social gatherings and family meals.
description: Costa Mesa Courtyards is a vibrant community shopping center located at 1835 Newport Boulevard in the heart of Costa Mesa, California. This popular destination has established itself as a go-to location for residents and visitors seeking quality dining and retail experiences in Orange County. With its convenient location and accessible layout, the center serves the surrounding neighborhoods with a carefully curated mix of tenants that cater to everyday needs and lifestyle preferences. The property maintains strong community appeal with a 4.3-star rating from over 1,400 reviews, reflecting its consistent service and tenant quality. Operating daily from 8:00 AM to 10:00 PM, Costa Mesa Courtyards provides flexible hours that accommodate both morning shoppers and evening diners, making it a versatile destination for the local community.
summary: Costa Mesa Courtyards is a well-regarded community shopping center on Newport Boulevard in Costa Mesa, offering a convenient mix of retail and dining options. With strong ratings and extended operating hours, it serves as a popular neighborhood destination for local residents and visitors.
